name: Usage Saver
tagline: Cost coach for agent work: less context, lighter tools, no wasted steps
description: It looks at how an AI-assisted task is set up and finds the parts of the bill you do not need: context that adds nothing, a heavyweight tool where a lighter one would do the job, and steps that earn nothing on the way to the result. Same tasks, handled with less, so the meter runs slower.
author: Draggen75
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
